title: Admin Read-Only Access to Any Student Course Material
description: The admin module shall return any student's syllabi, sections, homework, submissions, and grades without permitting mutations.
rationale: Admins need full read visibility into every student's course material for support and quality oversight, but editing or regenerating content is explicitly deferred to the interactive authoring flow; read-only access prevents accidental data changes while preserving the audit trail. The RLS policy must allow admins to read across all student rows while preserving strict per-student isolation so no student can read another student's data; verification must be performed under SET ROLE valory_app to prevent the superuser from masking RLS policy gaps.
